it was a very disappointing experience. From the moment we arrived, it was clear that this place is not suitable for families.

Firstly, the environment was quite unpleasant. The hotel is located in a noisy area, which made it difficult for us to get a good night’s sleep. Additionally, there were some questionable activities happening around the hotel, which made us feel unsafe, especially with kids around.

The biggest issue, however, was the hygiene. The room was far from clean. We found dust and dirt in several places, and the bathroom had mold and mildew. The bed linens and towels were stained and didn’t seem freshly laundered. This level of cleanliness is unacceptable and poses health risks.

Overall, I would not recommend this hotel to anyone, especially families. The poor environment and lack of hygiene made our stay very uncomfortable. We will definitely be looking for a different place to stay next time.
